lastCompletedStory.title: Add cam stats cycles and backfill the historical cycle rows

nextStoryContext: US-002 wired `cam stats cycles` (src/commands/stats.ts: runStatsCycles, mirroring runStatsTokens's injectable cwd/readEventLog/write/rebuild shape) plus a NEW pure formatter `serializeCycleMetrics(result)` in src/stats/cycles.ts (NDJSON: one JSON line for the header, then one per row, trailing newline). The artifact scripts/cam/cycle-metrics.jsonl is now committed (generated once via `bun index.ts stats cycles --rebuild`, verified idempotent and git-tracked). All 4 index.ts CLI registration points are wired: ParsedStatsArgs gained a `{ mode: 'cycles'; help: false; rebuild: boolean }` variant, STATS_USAGE/STATS_HELP.usage are now 'Usage: cam stats tokens|cycles' / 'cam stats tokens|cycles', dispatchStats has a real mode switch (deps.statsCyclesFn), STATS_HELP's Subcommands list and the top-level HELP entry (index.ts ~line 136, now 'stats tokens|cycles') both mention cycles. US-003 (Append a cycle-metrics row on main, in place) needs a NEW src/commands/cycle-metrics.ts on-main upsert/append writer targeting the SAME scripts/cam/cycle-metrics.jsonl path and the SAME NDJSON line shape (header first line, `serializeCycleMetrics`/CycleMetricsRow's exact field names are load-bearing since prior jq oracles select by name) -- reuse serializeCycleMetrics/CYCLE_METRICS_SCHEMA_VERSION from src/stats/cycles.ts rather than re-deriving the format. Per its own notes: port the on-main upsert pattern from src/commands/pattern-records.ts (readPatternRecordsContentFromMain, appendOutcomeToLine, per-attempt CAS-retry discipline), import the shared checkMainUpToDate/pushMainBestEffort from src/git/on-main.ts (a 5th private copy trips the jscpd gate), and do NOT copy the suggestions.jsonl precedent (that file is template-seeded on init, absent-file is a hard error there; this artifact instead bootstraps itself on first on-main append, no templates/ change, no embed-vendor). This branch's US-002 commit is the FIRST AND LAST time a feature branch may bulk-rewrite cycle-metrics.jsonl via --rebuild in a way that clobbers on-main appends -- from US-003 onward, only the on-main appender writes new rows (CAM-121 branch-clobber scar).
